scope: Additional targeted public-source recovery. Counts are reported by stream; repository occurrences, user searches and scientific documents are separate units. No native WoS/Scopus/IEEE/arXiv search is claimed.

bridge_author_and_library_stream.limit: Plausible usernames are not authenticated author identities; general Bitcoin-price documentation and code-only roots are not included as new studies.

deduplication_limit: Per-stream unique repository counts must not be summed as a deduplicated combined count; reused previously excluded PDFs are explicitly distinguished.
recovery_result: No new full primary source closes explicit shallow CNN1D support. README/code, price-level prediction, option-value prediction and directional classification are not substituted for volatility-regression evidence.

Aaltio2022.limit: Djanga2025 is secondary evidence. Similarity to Miura2019 wording does not prove a citation error and does not create another independent occurrence.

public_scope: Summary and documentary selection only; no third-party PDF or complete extracted text redistributed.
